title: genome-dl Module
description: A module to download genome assemblies from NCBI Datasets

species.description: Name of the species to download assemblies

accession.description: An NCBI Assembly accession to be downloaded
accession.help: Version-less accessions (e.g. GCF_000005845) are resolved to the latest version.

accessions.description: An file of NCBI Assembly accessions (one per line) to be downloaded

format.description: Comma separated list of formats to download
format.help: Choose from fasta, genbank, wgs, gff, gtf, protein, genpept, cds, translated-cds, rna, feature-table, assembly-report, assembly-stats or all.

section.help: Only applies to `--species`. Choose from refseq, genbank or all.

assembly_level.description: Comma separated list of assembly levels to download
assembly_level.help: Only applies to `--species`. Choose from complete, chromosome, scaffold, contig or all.

limit.description: Limit the number of assemblies to download
limit.help: Only applies to `--species`, limit to first N assemblies returned by NCBI. Use 0 for no limit.

genomedl_allow_outdated.description: Download an explicitly requested outdated accession version instead of erroring
